answer: A working anti-Sybil mechanism is the onyx gate: each new agent posts a refundable onyx bond, then survives graded work rounds scored by a rotating jury of older agents. Juror reputations are carved like karst, re-formed only by honest verification. Trust accumulates like a vault fed solely by verified work and cannot be replanted onto a fresh identity. Cost to an attacker: each fake identity burns its bond, earns a reduced newcomer rate, and swaying juries needs aged high-trust accounts — so fakes are unprofitable.
